space.$description: 4/8 scale. Use 4 and 12 inside components, multiples of 8 between them.

sans.$description: Inter self-hosted (woff2, OFL). Fallbacks keep layout if the font fails.

lg.$description: Card and section headings; body on phones.

pill.$description: Status pills and count badges only.

focus-offset.$description: Gap between control and focus ring.

density.$description: compact is the default (matches ui.css today); comfortable adds room. Phones force touch sizes.

control-height-sm.$description: Small buttons in toolbars and table rows.

touch.$description: Applied below breakpoint.md (768px) whatever the density.

xs.$description: Phone reference width; layouts must also work at 360px.

md.$description: Tablet: sidebar becomes the icon rail; tables may stay tabular.

xl.$description: Desktop: side panels (ticket context, filters) open beside content.

2xl.$description: Wide: more dashboard columns, not wider cards.

3xl.$description: Ultrawide / wallboard: max content width applies to forms and reading text only.

breakpoint.$description: min-width media queries. Bootstrap grid breakpoints (576/768/992/1200/1400) stay inside Bootstrap.

contrast-pairs.$description: Every pair must meet min. fg/bg are paths under theme.<theme>.color. 4.5 = WCAG 1.4.3 text; 3.0 = 1.4.11 non-text / large text / focus (2.4.13 guidance).

pairs.use: text (tooltip: inverse text on primary-text fill)
text (tooltip: inverse text on primary-text fill)

icon.$description: Semantic icon map: one icon per concept in every app. fa = Font Awesome Free 6 canonical name (solid style unless noted, vendored in Clientst0r). lucide = equivalent Lucide name for apps that adopt Lucide; checked by name only, not vendored here. retired = FA 5 alias names still in Clientst0r templates, to be replaced by the canonical name.

nav-customers.use: Customers / Clients group and a customer record

nav-knowledge.use: Knowledge and Vault group, KB article

app-switcher.use: Application switcher button (only when a peer is configured)

action-edit.use: Edit a record (use pen for inline field edit)

action-external.use: Opens outside the page / in a peer app
